item.description:
• Choose how tracks are named. Settings ▸ File Output ▸ File Names builds a file name from the track's disc and track number, title, artist and album: type / to insert one. Pick what spaces become, and whether single-disc releases carry a disc number. Names are kept safe for Mac, Linux and Windows disks and network shares, and long names are shortened evenly to fit.
  • Rename files from Edit Metadata…. Tick “Rename files to match the file naming setting” and Save renames every file from its tags. The new names show in the list before you save.
  • Look up a release in Edit Metadata…. Search MusicBrainz and Discogs from the editor and apply a release's titles, track numbers and album details to the files in one step. Track lengths are compared with the files so a wrong match or a wrong order stands out.
  • Drag files into order in Edit Metadata…, and play the start of any file to check which track it is.
  • Shows potentially missing audio files, based on the release's track information from MusicBrainz or Discogs.

This beta works through November 30, 2026. Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26.5 or later.
